name: FAV (Fabricatable Voxel) Format
definition: A voxel-based 3D data format where a model is represented as a 3D buildup of volume cells (voxels) on a grid, allowing free design of internal structures, materials, colors, and connection intensities, unlike mesh-based formats (STL, AMF, 3MF) which are limited to surface definitions.
summary: FAV is an XML-based voxel format enabling internal structure design and fabrication, unlike mesh formats limited to surfaces.
